title: Single agent
sub: The model writes a short plan, then picks each action itself and decides when to stop.

steps.d:
"What does the DW-300's drain pump cost, and
how long is it under warranty?"

steps.h: The model writes a plan; your code moves on regardless of what it says
steps.d:
"1. Search for the DW-300 warranty term.
2. Look up the drain pump's part number and price."

steps.h: The model chooses to search first
Your code returns the search results
steps.d:
warranty-policy#1 (2-year full warranty),
parts-list#2 (drain pump listed, no price shown here)

steps.h: The model looks up the exact part instead of trusting the search snippet
Your code returns the part line
The model decides it has enough and stops
steps.d:
"The DW-300 drain pump (HLV-2201) is $46.00.
It is covered under the 2-year full warranty."
